introducer.title: Remove external DNS dependency from browser tools test

cases.mechanism: The prior remote-test path awaited creation of a localhost tunnel before invoking the browser tool, with no local timeout or cancellation around `workspace.openTunnel`; a failed Windows bind could leave the test blocked until Mocha's 60-second timeout.
cases.symptom: The remote browser-tools integration scenario could spend the full 60-second test timeout waiting for tunnel creation instead of opening the page.
cases.fixedBehavior: The replacement invokes the browser tool directly and removes the local fixture and awaited tunnel setup, eliminating the tunnel-creation wait from the remote path.
cases.evidence: Base line 281 is the awaited `vscode.workspace.openTunnel` call inside the `vscode.env.remoteName` path, and the test has a 60,000 ms timeout. The review context identifies a Windows Remote run where the adjacent-port bind returned EACCES and the promise did not settle. Added line 265 directly invokes the browser tool without tunnel setup. `blame_base_line` resolves the old mechanism to commit 2302cc68e96b866a7e2ece80c9b134d7a3de7ed7.
